faqs.a: Palak Tripathi is a Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS) student and aspiring full-stack developer who combines technical engineering with creative technology and thoughtful design.

Palak works with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS on the frontend; Node.js, Express.js, and REST APIs on the backend; Java (OOP & Data Structures) and SQL for core software and databases; plus Git, GitHub, Vite, and Web Audio API.

faqs.q: Is Palak a frontend or backend developer?
faqs.a: Palak is an aspiring full-stack developer. She has strong strengths in frontend architecture (React, UI/UX, responsive layouts) as well as solid backend foundations in Node.js, Express, REST APIs, Java, and SQL databases.

PRICORA-AI is an AI-powered content and marketing generator created by Palak Tripathi. It generates high-converting marketing copy, pricing intelligence, and campaign assets. Code: https://github.com/palak-tripathi/pricora-ai-content-generator | Live demo: https://pricora-ai-content-generator.vercel.app

Palak has built 'PRICORA-AI' (an AI content and pricing intelligence generator), 'Sentinel AI' (an AI-assisted security and monitoring dashboard), 'Story in Stills and Sound' (this interactive portfolio featuring an acoustic piano synthesizer and 3D diary), and full-stack web applications with React, Node, Express, and SQL.

faqs.q: What was Palak's role in Sentinel AI?
faqs.a: In Sentinel AI, Palak was the Frontend Architecture and API Integration Lead. She designed the responsive monitoring dashboard, real-time alert widgets, and connected the AI analytics endpoints.
Yes! Palak is actively open and available for software engineering and full-stack development internships. You can reach her directly at palak09.learner@gmail.com.

Palak combines strong technical fundamentals (Java OOP, React, Node, SQL) with a CSBS background that understands business systems and product outcomes. She is a dedicated builder, self-driven learner, and brings genuine creativity and attention to detail to every project.
You can contact Palak via email at palak09.learner@gmail.com, connect on LinkedIn, check her code on GitHub, or follow her creative journey on Instagram (@palak.tripathi_).
